what_it_is.prose: Solar Industries is India's largest domestic manufacturer of industrial explosives and initiating systems, and the parent of Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited (SDAL) — which has emerged as a key private-sector Indian loitering-munition OEM. Through subsidiary Economic Explosives Ltd (EEL), Solar developed the Nagastra-1 loitering munition (480 units delivered to the Indian Army by Dec 2024, beating Polish WB Electronics and Israeli UVision). Nagastra-2 (20 kg, 4 kg anti-tank warhead, two-man portable) and Nagastra-3 (~100 km range) are under accelerated development; Solar plans layered loitering munitions with up to 700 km deep-strike capability. Solar is ranked among the Top 5 global explosives companies and booked ₹2,650 Cr in orders + ₹1,400 Cr export orders (2025). The company is investing ₹12,700 Cr in Nagpur defence/aerospace. Q4FY25 PAT climbed 42% YoY to ₹346 Cr; annual revenue ₹7,540 Cr (+24% YoY).
